independentReview.reason: The review contract requires a blocked verdict when the next certification step depends on a manually established authenticated local QA session.

coverage.agentPassesCompleted: 17/17 review lanes represented; authenticated execution blocked

evidence: scripts/qa/v3-10b-local-audit.mjs captured dashboard-390x844.png with no visible canonical logo image.
src/features/auth/AuthPage.tsx:61-65 renders the canonical registry asset but CSS suppresses it on V3 auth.
findings.observed: The first V3 login viewport shows the textual CostaClean CRM kicker but the canonical logo asset is hidden.
findings.expected: The approved V3 auth direction should expose a deliberate, proportionally sized canonical brand mark or document an explicit text-only decision.
findings.rootCause: A V3-specific CSS rule hides the semantic logo registry output.
findings.designPrinciple: Brand presence should be restrained but the authenticated entry surface must remain recognizably Costa Clean.
findings.impact: Weakens brand recognition at the first operational entry point; does not block login.
findings.recommendedFix: In a later approved visual slice, either remove the hide rule and validate the canonical asset at mobile/tablet/desktop, or replace the hidden asset with an explicitly approved text-only treatment.
findings.regressionRisk: Low to medium; auth card height and first-viewport hierarchy can change.
findings.testRequired: Visual auth baseline at 390x844, 768x1024 and 1440x900 plus asset-load assertion.

findings.routeSurface: client contact actions, V3 shell ghost actions and related workspaces
findings.viewportState: mobile/tablet static CSS; authenticated runtime unavailable
evidence: src/v3/clients/V3ContactActions.tsx uses .v3-contact-action for operational contact links.
src/v3/shell/V3ShellChrome.tsx uses .v3-action--ghost for a shell action.
AGENTS.md requires interactive targets to be at least 44x44 CSS px.
findings.observed: Two reusable V3 action classes explicitly permit a 40 px minimum height, below the repository accessibility contract.
findings.expected: Interactive V3 controls should meet a 44 px minimum target, or have a documented native/semantic exception.
findings.rootCause: Shared V3 action CSS uses a smaller minimum than the cross-module touch-target rule.
findings.impact: Potentially undersized contact and secondary actions on touch devices; exact rendered geometry remains unverified for authenticated surfaces.
findings.recommendedFix: In a later correction slice, raise the shared minimum to the approved touch token or document a verified exception, then rerun geometry and keyboard checks.
findings.regressionRisk: Medium; changing shared action height affects shell and CRM density.
findings.testRequired: Authenticated geometry at 390x844, 768x1024 and 1440x900; keyboard focus and hit-area assertions.

findings.routeSurface: invoice/quote print and clipboard fallback actions
evidence: src/features/documents/utils.ts:54-56 uses window.alert for clipboard fallback feedback.
src/features/invoices/openInvoicePrintWindow.tsx:77 uses window.alert when popups are blocked.
src/features/quotes/openQuotePrintWindow.tsx:92 uses window.alert when popups are blocked.
findings.observed: Some document-action failures use browser-native blocking alerts instead of the app's inline/status feedback system.
findings.expected: Non-destructive document failures should preserve context and provide an accessible, dismissible in-app status where the surrounding flow supports it.
findings.rootCause: Legacy utility and print-window fallback paths still call window.alert.
findings.impact: Interrupts flow and makes feedback inconsistent; not a data-integrity issue.
findings.recommendedFix: Evaluate a later document-output UX slice; preserve native popup-blocker guidance where technically necessary and add focused focus/announcement tests.
findings.regressionRisk: Low to medium; changing feedback timing can affect existing export tests.
findings.testRequired: Popup-blocked and clipboard-unavailable local tests with focus and accessible status assertions.

auditBlockers.requiredNextAction: User must manually authenticate the existing local QA browser/profile, or provide an already authorized authenticated local session through the approved environment. No credentials were requested or manipulated.
